# Kirkland Dispatch

> The Kirkland Dispatch is a free weekly email newsletter about Kirkland, WA, sent Thursdays at 6 AM Pacific and published by Neighborhood Press LLC. It covers city council decisions, land-use and permit notices, road and transit changes, school district news, openings and closings, with one section per neighborhood. Every item links its public source. It is researched and written with AI tools, and an editor reads every issue before it goes out.

## Key pages
- [This week in Kirkland](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/this-week/): the dated items for the current week, updated every Thursday
- [Kirkland news](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/news/): every story, newest first
- [Reader asked](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/asked/): readers' questions answered from the public record
- [Standards](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/standards/): publisher, sources, sponsors, corrections
- [Subscribe](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/): free, one email a week

## Neighborhoods
- [Central Houghton](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/central-houghton/): Upland Houghton along 108th Avenue NE, Northwest University, and the Cross Kirkland Corridor running through the middle.
- [Everest](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/everest/): Everest Park's ballfields and creek trail, the Kirkland Avenue corridor, and the streets rising toward I-405.
- [Evergreen Hill](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/evergreen-hill/): Kirkland's northeast corner, including greater Kingsgate, Edith Moulton Park and the Kingsgate Park & Ride.
- [Finn Hill](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/finn-hill/): The wooded ridge above Lake Washington with Big Finn Hill Park, O.O. Denny Park and Saint Edward State Park next door.
- [Highlands](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/highlands/): The hilltop pocket between the Cross Kirkland Corridor and I-405, with Highlands Park at its center.
- [Juanita](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/juanita/): Juanita Beach Park, the Juanita Bay Park boardwalks, and the Juanita Village streets at the north end of the lake.
- [Lakeview](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/lakeview/): The Lake Washington Boulevard shoreline: Houghton Beach, Carillon Point and the Yarrow Bay wetlands.
- [Market](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/market/): The Market Street historic district, Heritage Park, Waverly Beach and the streets north of downtown.
- [Moss Bay](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/moss-bay/): Downtown Kirkland's waterfront: Marina Park, the Lake Street shops, Peter Kirk Park and the transit center.
- [Norkirk](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/norkirk/): Kirkland City Hall, Crestwoods Park, and the grid of streets between Market Street and the Cross Kirkland Corridor.
- [North Rose Hill](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/north-rose-hill/): East of I-405 and north of NE 85th Street, with Forbes Lake, Mark Twain Park and the NE 85th station area taking shape.
- [South Rose Hill / Bridle Trails](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/south-rose-hill-bridle-trails/): East of I-405 from NE 85th Street south to the equestrian trails of Bridle Trails State Park.
- [Totem Lake](https://www.kirklanddispatch.com/totem-lake/): Kirkland's urban center: The Village at Totem Lake, EvergreenHealth, the Totem Lake Park boardwalk and the north end of the Cross Kirkland Corridor.
